component.name: Aerox 5 Control
component.summary: Configure the SteelSeries Aerox 5 Wireless on Linux

description.p: Aerox 5 Control is an independent Linux utility for the SteelSeries Aerox 5 Wireless mouse.
It provides a native GTK4 and Libadwaita interface for viewing device status, battery level and charging state, and for configuring DPI presets and polling rate over the 2.4 GHz receiver.
Wired USB mode supports device status, battery level and charging information in version 0.1.0.

ul.li: Native GTK4 and Libadwaita graphical interface
2.4 GHz and wired USB device detection
